title: Version catalogue and safe-pivot orchestrator for private control planes
creator: Arielle Tan
description: Introduce a version catalogue and a safe-pivot orchestrator for Private (VPC) control plane upgrades. The goal is to provide deterministic, tenant-aware upgrade operations that can: 1) surface binary/CRD/operator compatibility per-version via a curated catalogue, 2) instantiate a snapshot-based canary (lightweight policy+state snapshot) for targeted tenants, 3) perform controlled traffic pivots and observability gates, and 4) execute deterministic rollbacks if health gates fail. This ticket covers the design, Terraform/IaC module changes, operator coordination, preflight checks, health probes, and the rollout playbook required for an enterprise-safe upgrade path.
acceptance_criteria: Version catalogue stored in durable config store with metadata (schema, minimum runtime, incompatible APIs)
Terraform modules expose catalog selection and canary-snapshot flags for private stacks
Orchestrator can execute a tenant-scoped snapshot canary and run health gates (latency, error-rate, reconcile-rate) before promotion
Automated rollback path restores control plane operator and tenant state within documented RTO for failing gates
Audit trail and KMS-encrypted logs for all upgrade steps available in customer audit logs
End-to-end test harness simulates 3 tenant cohorts with injected failure scenarios
design_decisions_and_tradeoffs: Use snapshot-based canaries instead of shadow clusters to reduce infra cost and shorten promotion time, trading off deeper isolation for faster feedback
Catalogue will be authoritative source-of-truth for version compatibility; initial catalogue populated from CI artifacts and curated by SRE/Research
Orchestrator will rely on existing telemetry pipeline (Console traces + per-route latency) rather than building separate metrics collectors to minimize duplication
Terraform surface will be minimal (catalog version + canary selectors) and delegate mechanics to control-plane operator to avoid proliferating IaC complexity
implementation_notes: Add 'version_catalog' Terraform module under private/modules/controlplane to accept fingerprints and compatibility tags
Operator component exposes API: /orchestrate/upgrade {version, selectors, snapshot=true} and a /orchestrate/rollback endpoint
Health gates: 95th latency, 5xx rate, Prometheus reconcile-duration; thresholds configurable per-catalog entry
Add audit events for each step to cloudwatch/stackdriver with structured fields for customer_id, snapshot_id, version
Create e2e test suite using KinD + mocked tenant data to validate snapshot apply/rollback within CI pipeline
